rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality expanded/hatching blastocyst, but it overstates certainty about ICM and TE quality from this single image and localizes structures somewhat speculatively.

It mentions age, embryo quality, and PCOS/AMH, but the response is truncated and does not meaningfully integrate most clinical factors such as ovarian reserve, prior cycle history, sperm parameters, endometrium, or transfer timing.
The reasoning presented is generally logical and internally consistent, but it is incomplete and stops before addressing prognosis, risks, or recommendations in a full evidence-linked way.
What is present is broadly compatible with Gardner grading and standard IVF interpretation, but the incomplete response prevents demonstration of full guideline-based assessment or recommendations.
No practical transfer or future-cycle recommendations are actually provided in the visible response, so it offers little clinical utility.
